name: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models (arXiv:2201.11903)
notes: arXiv:2201.11903. Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models. By Jason Wei et al. (Google). Submitted 2022-01-28. Demonstrates that prompting LLMs with intermediate reasoning steps improves performance on arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning tasks.
